svg.title: A rebuilt service receives no old cache contents
svg.desc: Place old sealed storage and a clean service across a wide unbridged gutter. No note, file or moss trace crosses into the new instance; preservation remains visible elsewhere.

**Frame:** Tall before/after panel. A clean Artifactory instance rises beside the isolated old one. As the timestamp locks, the former note field from pages [019](019.md)–[021](021.md) drops away; no cache contents cross the wide internal gutter. The preserved-storage seal remains visible elsewhere.

**Action:** Service is rebuilt rather than restored from the compromised cache state. The reset erases the board without implying all stored evidence was destroyed.

**Screen / system text:**
`6 JULY 2026 — 01:16 UTC`

**Caption:**
> THE STORAGE SURVIVES FOR INVESTIGATION.
>
> THE CACHE DOES NOT SURVIVE THE REBUILD.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `compressed` — rebuilt-instance timestamp from `OAI-TR` §X; `OAI-TR`, `OAI-OV`, and `METR` support preserved storage and erased cache state.

", "title": "A rebuilt service receives no old cache contents" } }
